decisions.title: STRICT generated documentation authority
decisions.decision: Use .workflow machine-readable semantic specs plus deterministic Project Truth Compiler as upstream documentation authority; generated canonical Markdown under docs/ is a read-only projection.
decisions.rationale: The project is financial/ML/audit-sensitive and frequently handed across agents; deterministic generation prevents drift and manual self-reference.

decisions.title: MTF-1 remains data authority only
decisions.decision: MTF-1 establishes causal multi-timeframe data/closure authority and does not activate future hierarchical H4/H1/M15/M5 trading execution.
decisions.rationale: Scientific sequencing requires data causality/external proof before strategy implementation.

decisions.title: Explicit Challenger to Champion promotion
decisions.decision: Strategy and Model winners first become Challengers; Champion replacement requires explicit legal promotion.
decisions.rationale: Prevents automated research results from mutating production authority.

decisions.title: Scientist remains advisory
decisions.decision: LLM Scientist may reason, review and propose bounded experiments but deterministic code owns admission, gates, protected evidence and promotion.
decisions.rationale: Separates creative research assistance from auditable scientific and production authority.

decisions.title: AFTER sequence reconstruction for existing code
decisions.decision: Adopt new sequence contracts in AFTER mode for existing MAX implementation; do not fabricate retrospective BEFORE plans.
decisions.rationale: Skill_Workflow sequence governance was introduced after the implementation already existed.

decisions.title: MTF-2 finite-window role features
decisions.decision: MTF-2 V1 uses compact role-specific finite-window market features from canonical M5-derived views. It does not default to 4 x CP32, recursive EMA/ADX/RSI dependencies, or repeated rule-family/rule_meta_score features across roles. M15 remains the directional owner.
decisions.rationale: Finite windows make dependency_start_time exact and auditable, reduce duplicated rule-engine bias, and isolate incremental timeframe information before model-complexity escalation.

decisions.title: Typed-time label horizon is mandatory
decisions.decision: Future M5 may be used only for post-decision directional labels/evaluation. A real label horizon must be explicit in minutes or derived from max_hold_bars only when bar_minutes/timeframe lineage is explicit. Legacy max_hold_bars by itself fails closed and cannot become purge authority.
decisions.rationale: Current legacy Strategy authority records max_hold_bars but not its timeframe; silently interpreting 54 as H1, M15 or M5 would change the economic horizon by multiples and invalidate purge semantics.

decisions.title: MTF-2 new implementation uses genuine BEFORE sequence governance
decisions.decision: Freeze the MTF-2 source-call plan before implementation. Existing pre-sequence code remains represented in AFTER mode; the future MTF-2 BEFORE session will bind this frozen planning commit to the implemented actual graph rather than fabricating a retrospective plan.
decisions.rationale: MTF-2 has not been implemented yet, so this is the first phase where genuine plan-before-code lineage is available.

decisions.title: Supersede MTF-2 V1 cyclic-time duplication before research
decisions.decision: MAX_MTF2_ROLE_FEATURE_LABEL_V1 is not edited retrospectively. V2 supersedes it before model experiments by removing M5 hour_sin/hour_cos because M15 and latest-closed M5 share the same decision timestamp, making those cyclic-time values exact duplicates. V2 also preregisters deterministic redundancy reporting and defers trained permutation/ablation claims until MTF-3 purge authority passes.
decisions.rationale: Keeping the frozen V1 history preserves preregistration lineage; removing exact duplicate time features reduces redundant dimensionality without using protected outcome evidence.

decisions.title: Supersede MTF-2 V2 exact body-return duplicates before research
decisions.decision: MAX_MTF2_ROLE_FEATURE_LABEL_V2 remains immutable history. V3 removes signed_body_atr from H1, M15 and M5 because V2 targeted redundancy evidence showed exact equality with ret_1_atr on continuous canonical bars. No trained outcome or protected holdout evidence is used for this repair.
decisions.rationale: The smallest correct schema keeps one representation of the same one-bar move rather than weakening duplicate detection or carrying redundant dimensions into research.

decisions.title: MTF-3 uses exact timestamp overlap with D-common comparison dependency
decisions.decision: MTF-3 replaces guessed bar-count purge for MTF research with exact per-sample timestamp intervals. Protected validation/test outcome windows start at M15 decision_time and end at max(label_end_time, execution_end_time). A train sample is removed whenever its full dependency/outcome interval intersects or touches a protected window. A/B/C/D comparisons use the D-complete dependency_start authority so folds and purged decision IDs are identical across ablations. While the M5 execution label is inactive, execution_end_time equals label_end_time; any future execution layer must supply an explicit timestamp.
decisions.rationale: Exact timestamps remove ambiguity across H4/H1/M15/M5 horizons, while one D-common dependency authority prevents feature-role ablations from being confounded by different training samples.

decisions.title: MTF-4 keeps M15 as sole direction owner
decisions.decision: MTF-4 deterministic strategy uses H4 context, H1 setup and latest-closed M5 timing only as veto gates around the existing M15 directional strategy. No higher/lower timeframe may originate or reverse direction, and MTF-4 does not introduce a future-M5 wait state.
decisions.rationale: This proves incremental deterministic MTF geometry with the smallest behavioral change, preserves role clarity, and leaves the dedicated M5 execution state machine to MTF-7.
